Commercialization

Define pricing, packaging, and commercial models that capture value and drive growth.

Know Learn Do
Know

What is Commercialization?

Understand what you own, what great looks like, and how to measure it.

⚠️ Needs PMM Validation
Role Card

What this area is

Commercialization is the practice of translating product value into pricing, packaging, and commercial structures. It ensures SAP captures fair value while making it easy for buyers to purchase and adopt solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Develop pricing strategies and models
  • Design packaging and bundling options
  • Create commercial playbooks
  • Support deal desk with pricing guidance
  • Monitor competitive pricing dynamics

Key deliverables

  • Pricing framework and rationale
  • Packaging and SKU structure
  • Commercial playbook
  • Deal desk guidance materials
  • Pricing competitive analysis
Playbook
1

Value analysis

Quantify customer value delivered. Map value drivers to pricing levers.

2

Pricing model design

Define pricing structure — per-seat, consumption, outcome-based. Test models against competitive alternatives.

3

Packaging development

Create packages that align to buyer segments and use cases. Define good-better-best options.

4

Enablement & governance

Train sales on pricing rationale and discounting guidelines. Establish approval workflows.

5

Performance monitoring

Track pricing realization, discount rates, and competitive win rates. Adjust based on data.

Success Metrics
Price Realization
Actual vs. list price captured
Deal Velocity
Time to close by package type
Discount Rate
Average discount across deals
Competitive Pricing Position
Price position vs. key competitors
